source.title: Application for Feast of Justice Registration

questions.label: First name
Last name
Zip Code
questions.note: A radio list of the ZIP codes served. The field rule only fits text boxes and selects; proposed rule: zipChoice (pick the saved ZIP, or Other when it is not listed). The page also has an "Other:" free-text option, left out here.

questions.label: Street Address
Apartment / suite number, if applicable
Phone number (to contact you)
Is that your home or cell phone?
questions.note: Home or cell phone; the profile keeps one reference phone. The page also has an "Other:" free-text option, left out here.

questions.note: Gender identity; not in the profile. The page also has an "Other:" free-text option, left out here.

questions.label: Nationality/Race
questions.note: Race; not in the profile. The page also has an "Other:" free-text option, left out here.

questions.label: Birth Date
Email Address (to contact you)
Have you contacted another group/organization for help in the last 10 days?
questions.note: Recent help from other groups; not in the profile.

questions.label: If so, which organization?
questions.note: Follow-up to the question before; not in the profile.

questions.label: Reason for food assistance (select all that apply)
questions.note: Reasons for needing food; the profile has no reasons, even though some options (disability, retired) touch saved facts. The page also has an "Other:" free-text option, left out here.

questions.label: Primary spoken language in household
questions.note: Household language; not in the profile.

questions.label: Do you need a language interpreter?
questions.note: Interpreter need; not in the profile.

questions.label: Country of Birth
questions.note: Country of birth; not in the profile.

questions.label: How long have you lived in the UNITED STATES?
questions.note: Time lived in the US; not in the profile.

questions.label: How long have you lived in Northeast Philadelphia?
questions.note: Time lived in Northeast Philadelphia; not in the profile.

questions.label: How long have you lived in your current place of residence? (years/months)
questions.note: Time at the current address; not in the profile.

questions.label: How were you referred to us?
questions.note: How they heard about the pantry.

questions.label: How do you travel to Feast of Justice?
questions.note: Travel method; not in the profile. The page also has an "Other:" free-text option, left out here.

questions.label: Household dietary preferences or restrictions (select all that apply)
questions.note: Dietary needs. The page also has an "Other:" free-text option, left out here.

questions.label: Which cooking/food storage facilities do you have access to? (select all that apply)
questions.note: Kitchen and storage access; not in the profile.

questions.label: Is anybody in your household a veteran?
What public benefits do you receive? (select all that apply)
questions.note: Benefits currently received; the profile records what is being applied for, not what is received. The page also has an "Other:" free-text option, left out here.

questions.label: Would you like to be contacted by a benefits specialist to apply for public benefits? Refer to above question for public benefits options. If yes, a specialist from our partner agency, Jewish Family and Children's Services (JFCS), will contact you.
questions.note: Wants a call from a benefits specialist; a preference, not a saved fact.

questions.label: Annual household income level
questions.note: Ranges share end points ($15,000 is in two ranges). The page also has an "Other:" free-text option, left out here.

questions.label: Please list any sources of income (check all that apply)
options: Financial support of friend or family
questions.note: Income source types; the profile has earned and other income amounts, not their sources. The page also has an "Other:" free-text option, left out here.

questions.label: How many people live in your household?
Do you have any children under age 8 living in the home?
questions.note: "No" is certain when there are no children; otherwise their ages are unknown.

questions.label: Person 1: Full name
questions.note: Asked about another household member: the page shows it under "Person 1:" in the section for ALL OTHER household members, repeated for Persons 1-8 by household size; collected once.

questions.label: "The food that I bought just didn't last, and I didn't have money to get more." Was that often, sometimes, or never true for you/your household in the last 12 months?
questions.note: Optional food security screener; not in the profile.

questions.label: In the last 12 months, did you or other adults in your household ever cut the size of your meals or skip meals because there wasn't enough money for food?
questions.note: Optional food security screener; not in the profile.

questions.label: If so, how often did this happen?
options: Some months but not every month
questions.note: Optional food security screener; not in the profile.

questions.label: In the last 12 months, I worried that the food I was able to eat was bad for my health and well-being.
questions.note: Optional food security screener; not in the profile.

questions.label: During the past month, how often did you eat FRUITS like apples, bananas, oranges, melon, or any other fruits? INCLUDE fresh, frozen, canned, or dried fruit. DO NOT INCLUDE juices.
questions.note: Optional nutrition screener; not in the profile.

questions.label: During the past month, how often did you eat other VEGETABLES that were not deep fried? These are vegetables like carrots, broccoli, collards, green beans, corn, or other vegetables that are not deep fries. INCLUDE canned, frozen, and fresh vegetables.
questions.note: Optional nutrition screener. Label cut to the 300-character limit; the page continues: "ALSO INCLUDE vegetables that are raw, boiled, broiled, baked, stir fried, or microwaved."
